WITH manager_stats_by_team AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g > 0 THEN CAST(w AS FLOAT) / g ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
all_teams_with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_id,
    m.avg_win_rate,
    COALESCE(m.record_count, 0) as record_count
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team) t
  LEFT JOIN manager_stats_by_team m ON t.team_id = m.team_id
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as mean_win_rate
  FROM all_teams_with_stats
  WHERE avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  a.team_id,
  a.avg_win_rate,
  a.record_count,
  a.avg_win_rate - g.mean_win_rate as diff_from_mean
FROM all_teams_with_stats a
CROSS JOIN global_mean g
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN a.avg_win_rate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  diff_from_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct team_id from the team table is treated as a single team, with manager_half records aggregated across all years. The output shows one row per team_id rather than per (team_id, year) pair, matching the requested output format.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute per-year statistics for each (team_id, year) pair appearing in the team table, matching manager_half records by both team_id and year. This would produce many rows (potentially thousands) and differs from the 'top 10' framing suggesting ~100 teams.

WITH manager_stats_by_team_year AS (
  SELECT 
    mh.team_id,
    mh.year,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN mh.g > 0 THEN CAST(mh.w AS FLOAT) / mh.g ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate
  FROM manager_half mh
  GROUP BY mh.team_id, mh.year
),
team_year_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_id,
    t.year,
    COALESCE(ms.avg_win_rate, NULL) as avg_win_rate,
    COALESCE(ms.record_count, 0) as record_count
  FROM team t
  LEFT JOIN manager_stats_by_team_year ms ON t.team_id = ms.team_id AND t.year = ms.year
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as mean_win_rate
  FROM team_year_stats
  WHERE avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  tys.team_id,
  tys.year,
  tys.avg_win_rate,
  tys.record_count,
  tys.avg_win_rate - gm.mean_win_rate as diff_from_mean
FROM team_year_stats tys
CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN tys.avg_win_rate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  diff_from_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
